question: Can the registered order-five Shubin graph equivalence and the exact eight-component N^5 normal-order expansion be composed into a uniform one-site energy-to-number form bound, and then into the registered Gibbs/history top-tail interface?

shubin_graph.statement: For the compact onsite-source family, the closed quartic graph norm through m=5 is equivalent in both directions to the finite monomial family of anisotropic order at most five.
shubin_graph.scope: registered fixed-beta finite-periodic compact-source one-site Q3 family

normal_order.statement: The full eight-component N^5 normal-order expansion has finite coefficient l1 sum and every monomial has anisotropic creation/annihilation order at most five.

history_transport.statement: The registered periodic split histories have a uniform K_e^5 moment bound exp(G_transport T) S_mu^5 m5 in both orientations.
history_transport.scope: registered fixed-beta finite-periodic compact-source split histories only

exact_statement.graph_input: Assume the R-167 graph constant G_graph bounds the norm of every normal-ordered N^5 monomial of anisotropic order at most five by G_graph*||k_h^(5/2) psi|| on the common Schwartz/form core.
exact_statement.coefficient_sum: If N^5=sum_j c_j M_j and S=sum_j |c_j|, then |<psi,N^5 psi>| <= S G_graph ||psi|| ||k_h^(5/2) psi||.
exact_statement.form_bound: Since k_h>=1, N^5 <= S G_graph k_h^5 as closed quadratic forms on the core, with the constant uniform over the registered compact source family.
exact_statement.static_tail: A registered Gibbs state with phi(k_h^5)<=m5 therefore satisfies n^2 phi(P_top^(n)) <= S G_graph m5 n^2/(n-1)^5 for n>=2.
exact_statement.history_tail: A registered split-history state with phi(K_e^5)<=exp(G_transport T) S_mu^5 m5 satisfies the same top-tail bound with m5 replaced by exp(G_transport T) S_mu^5 m5, because k_x and K_e strongly commute and k_x<=K_e at an endpoint.
exact_statement.limit: The right side tends to zero, so the weighted truncated-CCR defect interface is supplied in the declared registered state/history scope.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: R282 formalizes the scalar composition and tail limits; the analytic Shubin equivalence and the Q3 history transport remain the cited authoritative premises.

boundary: This is a derived one-site Q3 domain/tail corollary in the registered R-167 scope. It does not construct the all-exhaustion common algebra, prove direct D or delta-D Cauchy convergence, identify one thermodynamic alpha, or close OS/KMS/GNS, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
no_overclaim: The graph-equivalence and fifth-history premises are not reproved by this package. No finite or conditional tail estimate is promoted to a state-independent thermodynamic automorphism theorem.

adversarial_review.check: Both lanes recompute the eight-component expansion and its coefficient l1 sum; no coefficient sum is pasted as a derived number.
The composition uses the stated R-167 graph-norm premise for every order-five monomial; it does not infer an operator power inequality from a scalar eigenvalue ratio.
The passage from |<psi,N^5 psi>| to the k_h^5 form uses the explicit equal-scale inequality and k_h>=1.
The history conclusion is restricted to the registered K_e^5 transport and endpoint strong-commutativity scope; no arbitrary onsite-interspersed or all-exhaustion history is inserted.
Direct D/delta-D, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
